panels.visual: Large opening panel: torchlit stone basement, cloaked anonymous client slides a portrait of long silver-haired Mikado across table to bob-haired assassin Aera. Chapter title integrated elegantly: 光を追う影. No sexual posing.
panels.dialogue: ナレーション「その朝、異世界の地下で――」／アエラ「……標的は、この男か」

panels.visual: Closeup Aera looking at the handsome portrait, tiny crack in her cool expression.
panels.dialogue: アエラ心中「……何、この顔。整いすぎじゃない？」

panels.visual: Aera fastens her dagger and melts into deep shadow, sharp silhouette.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……仕事だ。感情を挟むな、私」

panels.visual: Wide bright medieval royal market, Mikado in black long military coat buying potions and apples. Silver hair has very long trailing back hair.
panels.dialogue: ミカド心中「魔法薬と野営具……このくらいか」

panels.visual: Sakuya and Konoha approach through stalls, friendly greeting.
panels.dialogue: サクヤ「ミカドくん！ 奇遇だね」／ミカド「何だ、お前らも来てたのか」

panels.visual: Konoha shows sword maintenance supplies; Sakuya leans in seriously.
panels.dialogue: コノハ「王都の市場は品揃えがいい！」／サクヤ「最近、不審な噂があるから気をつけてね」

panels.visual: Mikado subtly notices a cold gaze among roof shadows.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……ああ。忠告感謝する」

panels.visual: Mikado leaves the classmates behind off panel, buys plain broad-brimmed hat and loose cloak over established uniform.
panels.dialogue: ミカド心中「……気のせい、か？」

panels.visual: On a tile rooftop, Aera studies the portrait then spots tall Mikado wearing the broad hat below.
panels.dialogue: アエラ心中「背格好、歩き方……間違いない」

panels.visual: Clock detail shows roughly morning nine, Mikado turns into quiet alley.
panels.dialogue: ミカド心中「昼からはホムラとの約束だ。先に用を済ませよう」

panels.visual: Aera silently drops into alley behind him, dagger still low, ominous long shadow.
panels.dialogue: アエラ心中「隙があれば、一撃で仕留める」

panels.visual: Top wide panel: Mikado stretches arms in an empty alley, hat on head; Aera launches silently from behind.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「んー……少し肩が凝ったな」

panels.visual: Diagonal action panel: Mikado pivots, dagger misses cloak, hat flies off. No wound or blood.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「――誰だ？」／効果音「ヒュッ」

panels.visual: Large bottom panel: beautiful unveiled Mikado face, long silver back hair glows in alley light. Small inset of Aera stunned with raised dagger.
panels.dialogue: アエラ心中「似顔絵……誇張じゃなかったの？」

panels.visual: Mikado stands poised while Aera resets her dagger stance, hat on ground.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「俺の背後を取るとは、なかなかやるな」

panels.visual: Closeup Aera regaining assassin expression, slight blush held in check.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……死んでもらうわ」

panels.visual: Multiple clean action arcs: Aera rushes with a flurry, Mikado evades by minimal movement.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「随分と物騒だな。誰の差し金だ？」

panels.visual: Mikado steps inside her range, open hand at safe distance by her throat, Aera startled.
panels.dialogue: アエラ心中「速い……間合いが！」

panels.visual: Aera bends low to break free of close range, shadow gathers around her blade.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「なめるな……ッ！」

panels.visual: Large diagonal panel: a lance-like black shadow extends from dagger toward Mikado, strong white speed lines.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「秘剣――影喰らい！」

panels.visual: Mikado calmly flicks flat of blade with one finger; shadow strike carves empty brick wall aside. No impact injury.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「――遅いな」／効果音「パァン！」

panels.visual: Aera looks at shattered wall then his hand in disbelief.
panels.dialogue: アエラ心中「私の必殺技が……指一本で！？」

panels.visual: Mikado catches Aera by the clothed shoulder and blocks her retreat against alley wall; nonsexual combat restraint, no pin-up.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「誰の依頼で俺を狙った？」

panels.visual: Aera glares back, jaw tight, dagger no longer raised.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……依頼人は売らない。殺しなさいよ」

panels.visual: Mikado changes subject, calm face in clean closeup.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「お前の名前は？」

panels.visual: Aera looks aside, reluctantly answers.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……アエラ」／ミカド「いい名前だ」

panels.visual: Mikado releases her and picks up broad hat, steps toward street.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「今日のところは、まあいい」

panels.visual: Over shoulder looking back at Aera, long hair moving with coat.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「次に会ったら、もういっぺん殺しに来い」

panels.visual: Aera grips dagger hilt, rattled, blushing through anger.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……次は、必ず殺すわ！」

panels.visual: Mikado exits with raised hand; Aera left alone in enormous quiet alley.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「ああ、楽しみにしている」

panels.visual: Aera alone leans against wall, tries to analyze defeat with cool expression.
panels.dialogue: アエラ心中「実力差……あの余裕……」

panels.visual: Closeup Aera suddenly covers blushing cheeks, tiny mental portrait of Mikado above. Nonsexual romantic reaction.
panels.dialogue: アエラ心中「でも、まず……顔が良すぎる！」

panels.visual: Noon city square: Mikado meets Homura, extremely long high ponytail and black eyepatch on HER RIGHT eye; she waves exuberantly.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「待ってたぜ、ミカド！」

panels.visual: They head toward huge guild door side by side.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「少し寄り道に付き合ってくれ」／ホムラ「おう！ 任せとけ！」

panels.visual: Big establishing panel of busy adventurer guild interior, quest board, reception queues. Homura and Mikado enter.
panels.dialogue: ナレーション「冒険者ギルド・王獣の牙」／ミカド「すごい人だな」

panels.visual: At quiet side desk anonymous bespectacled clerk drowning in paperwork under REPORTS sign; no repeated character reference.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……ここは任務報告の窓口か」

panels.visual: Homura wants to barge through crowded registration queue, Mikado lightly holds her shoulder.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「頼もしいが、目立つことはやめてな？」

panels.visual: Close Homura turns bright red then folds arms awkwardly, eyepatch still right side.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「あ、ああ！ 大人しくしてるぜ！」

panels.visual: At reception Elsa, an original supporting clerk with dark hair tied up and modest guild vest, passes registration forms to Mikado. Yuri visible at neighboring counter in established bob uniform.
panels.dialogue: エルザ「新規登録ですね。こちらの用紙へどうぞ」

panels.visual: Close Yuri sees Mikado for first time; eyes widen and blush, forms frozen in hands.
panels.dialogue: ユーリ心中「え……こんな綺麗な人、実在したんだ……」

panels.visual: Yuri pushes through partition to stand at Mikado counter, Elsa startled sideways, comedic no injury.
panels.dialogue: ユーリ「私、ユーリが担当いたしますっ！」／エルザ「ちょっと！ 私が先よ！」

panels.visual: Homura glowers at the two receptionists while Mikado sighs dryly.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「ミカドに色目使ってんじゃねーぞ」

panels.visual: Mikado fills form ignoring offscreen bickering; extreme closeup of writing avoids any age field. Visible name Mikado and 無属性, 剣 only.
panels.dialogue: ミカド心中「目立つのはやめようと言った矢先に……」

panels.visual: Mikado lays two forms down, Homura looks impatient.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「喧嘩は後にしてくれ。二人分、頼む」

panels.visual: Yuri checks the form with worried face.
panels.dialogue: ユーリ「無属性ですか？ 初心者向けの依頼になりますよ？」

panels.visual: Mikado points to simple quest board; Homura grins.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「ああ、それでいい。規定どおりに頼む」

panels.visual: Mikado plucks quest parchment from board, graphic five goblin silhouettes.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「このゴブリン五匹の討伐を頼む」

panels.visual: Yuri clutches quest stamp, trying to protect him from mundane danger.
panels.dialogue: ユーリ「初心者には、意外と危険なんですよ……！」

panels.visual: Homura slaps countertop with palm, puff of comic impact, no violence to clerk.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「さっさとハンコ押せっつってんだよ！」

panels.visual: Yuri stamps and hands cards, Mikado accepts with slight nod.
panels.dialogue: ユーリ「怪我をしたら、すぐ戻ってくださいね！」／ミカド「ありがとう。気をつけるよ」

panels.visual: Forest path afternoon, Mikado carries plain iron sword at waist, Homura stretches.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「いいね、こういうの。最初はEランクか」

panels.visual: Homura yawns then proposes fire with raised finger.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「森ごと燃やしちまえば一瞬だぜ」

panels.visual: Mikado lightly taps her head, comedic miniature expression.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「証明部位が残らないだろ。派手な真似はするなよ」

panels.visual: Three goblins emerge from bushes with clubs, heroes turn toward them.
panels.dialogue: 効果音「ガサッ」／ミカド「おっ。結構大きいな」

panels.visual: Dynamic diagonal sword sweep, goblin attackers only dark silhouettes dissolve into speed lines, no severed anatomy or gore.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……遅い」

panels.visual: Homura punches approaching goblin away in stylized impact cloud, no injury detail.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「さっすがミカド！」

panels.visual: Five defeated goblins kept distant and non-graphic; Mikado holds closed small proof sack.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「これで五匹。依頼は達成だ」

panels.visual: Homura looks at muddy boot in disgust, Mikado casts tiny cleaning light.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「弱いくせに、臭いだけは一人前だな！」／ミカド「……清浄」

panels.visual: Mikado abruptly pauses on forest path, Homura follows his gaze.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「あの木の影から……変な気配がしないか？」

panels.visual: Ancient trees bend, huge crowned draconic silhouette appears from forest, tiny heroes for scale.
panels.dialogue: 効果音「ズシン……」

panels.visual: Huge full-width reveal of Kiryu: original massive dragon with prismatic crystal-like armored scales rendered black white tones, crown horns, broad wings.
panels.dialogue: ナレーション「最上位魔物――輝龍」

panels.visual: Close Mikado looks up and smiles with challenge, hair flowing.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……面白くなってきたな」

panels.visual: Homura clenches fists grinning, right eyepatch and pauldrons clearly visible.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「ミカド、あいつはアタシがやってもいいか？」

panels.visual: Dragon releases colossal beam, Mikado stands between it and Homura with ordinary iron sword.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「俺も、久々に体を動かしたい」

panels.visual: Wide dynamic composition: Mikado sword cleaves beam into two streams around heroes, forest silhouettes blast far behind them.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「ははっ、いいぞ！」／効果音「バキィン！」

panels.visual: Iron sword chips and falls from Mikado hand in foreground, he calls to Homura.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「ホムラ！ 合わせろ！」

panels.visual: Homura launches into air with enormous sword of stylized white-hot flame; eyepatch correctly on her right eye.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「任せとけ！ 炎神剣――スルト！」

panels.visual: Dragon swings tail; Mikado slides below its side and kicks jaw upward, non-graphic impact star.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……隙だらけだ」

panels.visual: Hero looking up to airborne Homura, dragon lifted off balance between them.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「ホムラ、そこだ！」

panels.visual: Large diagonal panel Homura summons wolf-shaped fire jaw surrounding dragon silhouette, crisp black white blazing lines.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「喰らい尽くせ！ 獄炎狼牙――フェンリル！」

panels.visual: Mikado leaps through white flare and delivers clean decisive light stroke; dragon only silhouette, no dismemberment visible.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……終わりだ」

panels.visual: Wide quiet aftermath dragon lies motionless behind dust with intact outline, heroes land shoulder to shoulder.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「やったぜ！ アタシたちのコンビだな！」

panels.visual: Mikado mischievous face, Homura catches same idea.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「これ、持って行ったらどんな反応されるんだろうな」

panels.visual: Mikado holds small communication device beside immense defeated dragon in distance.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「シュミール、大きめの収納袋を持ってきてくれ」

panels.visual: Portal opens, Shumiru with her established brown curled twin ponytails, goggles on cap, cargo trousers and craft gear emerges carrying sacks and sheathed sword.
panels.dialogue: シュミール「お待たせしたッス！ ……えええっ！？」

panels.visual: Shumiru stares up at dragon wide-eyed; Homura proudly hands on hips.
panels.dialogue: シュミール「輝龍じゃないッスか！？」／ホムラ「アタシらにかかれば一瞬だぜ！」

panels.visual: Shumiru excitedly points at scales and tusks with sparkling eyes.
panels.dialogue: シュミール「この素材、少し分けてほしいッス！」

panels.visual: Mikado casually manifests clean light katana, dragon remains shown only as distant outline.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……面倒だな。俺がやるか」

panels.visual: Large white panel with dozens of precise clean light arcs, hands and face of Mikado; no anatomical gore.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「そいやっ」／効果音「シュパパッ」

panels.visual: Dragon parts now neatly sorted piles of scales bones gems and wrapped material, no raw organs; Shumiru stunned.
panels.dialogue: シュミール「……へ？」

panels.visual: Shumiru gleefully collects a tooth and a scale while Homura admires work.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「必要な分は持っていけ」／シュミール「ありがとうございますッス！」

panels.visual: Shumiru presents plain-looking straight sword with black sheath to Mikado, proud craftsman posture.
panels.dialogue: シュミール「普通の鉄剣に見えて、強度はオリハルコン並みッス！」

panels.visual: Mikado checks blade edge then smiles gently at Shumiru, not flirtatious body framing.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「さすがの出来栄えだ。後で使わせてもらう」

panels.visual: Shumiru waves through portal with materials, Homura and Mikado close storage bags.
panels.dialogue: シュミール「最高のものを作るッス！」

panels.visual: Mikado and Homura arrive at guild counter with large sack, Yuri looks relieved.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「おい、受付！ ゴブリン討伐、終わったぜ！」

panels.visual: Mikado places small closed proof bag first on counter, Yuri checking notes.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「まずゴブリン五匹。……あと、これ。おまけだ」

panels.visual: He drops large storage sack on counter; Yuri opens it expecting herbs.
panels.dialogue: ユーリ「おまけ……薬草でしょうか？」

panels.visual: Huge middle panel: radiant dragon horn and scales rise from sack; Yuri and Elsa eye-popping stunned faces, crowd behind freezes.
panels.dialogue: ユーリ「き、輝龍の……！？」／エルザ「うそでしょ！？」

panels.visual: Homura doubles over laughing, Mikado composed beside her.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「ぎゃははっ！ いい顔すんじゃねーか！」

panels.visual: Original Elsa supporting clerk sweats at ledger, Yuri also stunned, Mikado waits.
panels.dialogue: エルザ「ギルドの資金じゃ、とても買い取れません！」

panels.visual: Mikado tilts head as if trivial, Homura grins.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「無理なく出せる額で構わない」

panels.visual: Yuri rushes back saying guild master wants to meet, Mikado waves it aside.
panels.dialogue: ユーリ「マスターが直接お会いしたいと……」／ミカド「あー、そういうのいい」

panels.visual: Large comedic Mikado one finger raised, receptionists recoil.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「相場の百分の一でどうだと、伝えてくれ」

panels.visual: Guild door swings open, Charle and Ashe in established school clothes enter, sharply observant.
panels.dialogue: シャルル「……騒がしいわね」

panels.visual: Mikado turns casually, Homura defensive beside him.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「あれ、先輩たち」／ホムラ「ミカドの知り合いか？」

panels.visual: Charle and Ashe look at dragon material sack in shock.
panels.dialogue: アッシェ「その中身……まさか、輝龍か？」／シャルル「あなたが、これを！？」

panels.visual: Mikado points thumb toward proud Homura.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「ホムラと二人ですよ。たまたま出くわしましてね」

panels.visual: Yuri sets bag of coins on counter; Mikado stores it into small magic space, Ashe gapes behind.
panels.dialogue: ユーリ「百分の一で、大金貨百枚です……！」

panels.visual: Mikado heads out with Homura, Ashe calls after him from background, clear separate speech tails.
panels.dialogue: アッシェ「学園に戻ったら、生徒会室へ来い！」／ミカド「タバコやめてくれたら考えまーす」

panels.visual: Split visual montage: gossip across market; Yuri blushes into her hands back at counter.
panels.dialogue: ユーリ「ミカドさん……何より、顔が……！」

panels.visual: Street food stall Mikado and Homura share view of city, not food mouth contact.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「もっとすごい奴、狩ってみたくないか？」／ホムラ「いいねぇ！」

panels.visual: Royal library Mikado reads book with seven symbolic crowns, Homura perched by table bored then interested.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「魔王の魔力を受けて強化された魔物……魔王種か」

panels.visual: They return to guild counter; Yuri raises eyes, Elsa lays ominous quest sheet.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「一番難しい依頼を頼む」

panels.visual: Close parchment map east of capital marked cave, no dense tiny text.
panels.dialogue: エルザ「特Sランク、大悪魔の討伐です。憤怒の魔王サタニアの配下と推定されています」

panels.visual: Mikado folds quest, Homura tightens gauntlet with eager grin.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「温厚な魔王でも、配下はそうとは限らないか。……行くぞ」

panels.visual: Fast montage of Mikado and Homura traveling across landscape with long motion trail; discreet Aera silhouette follows far behind.
panels.dialogue: ナレーション「徒歩なら半日の道を、二人は瞬く間に踏破した」

panels.visual: At cave mouth Mikado offers cloth purification mask to Homura; she beams.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「マスク、いるか？」／ホムラ「おっ、サンキュー！」

panels.visual: They enter huge gloomy cave; broken shields and abandoned armor show danger, no corpses detail.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「進むほど、気配が強まるな」

panels.visual: From darkness a horned winged armored archdemon towers amid lesser shadow demons.
panels.dialogue: 大悪魔「また愚かな人間が迷い込んだか！」

panels.visual: Archdemon has black full fantasy armor, goatlike horns, bat wings, original design; lesser demons behind. Heroes remain much smaller.
panels.dialogue: 大悪魔「我はサタニア様の力を授かりし、大悪魔ぞ！」

panels.visual: Mikado side-eyes dramatic armor and turns to Homura, half-smile.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……大げさな格好だな。ホムラ、任せていいか？」

panels.visual: Homura shows teeth in eager grin, fire ignites round fist; right eyepatch unmistakable.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「任せとけ！ 三分で丸焦げにしてやる！」

panels.visual: Lesser demons rush down from archdemon hand gesture, silhouette action.
panels.dialogue: 大悪魔「行け、眷属ども！ 八つ裂きにしろ！」

panels.visual: Tall dominant panel Homura stands in blazing circular domain, tiny demons dissolve into dark smoke and sparks, no injury detail.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「燃えカスも残さねぇ！ 灼熱神域――ムスペルヘイム！」

panels.visual: Close archdemon recoils with widened eyes, armor reflects blaze.
panels.dialogue: 大悪魔「馬鹿な……貴様、ただの人間ではないな！？」

panels.visual: Homura walks forward with fearless grin; Mikado behind safe transparent shield calmly observing.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「アタシはミカドに仕える、最高の剣だ！」

panels.visual: Archdemon gathers massive black flame sphere between armored hands.
panels.dialogue: 大悪魔「黒死の業火――ヘルフレイム！」

panels.visual: Homura faces black flame without retreat, huge sword of white flame in hands.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「その程度の炎で、アタシを飲めるかよ！」

panels.visual: Large diagonal action clash white-hot sword against black fire, cave rocks shake, sparks, strong controlled screentones.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「炎神剣――スルト！」／効果音「ゴオォッ！」

panels.visual: Archdemon pushed back into smoke, Homura still standing certain.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「借り物の力で、調子に乗ってんじゃねぇ！」

panels.visual: Archdemon retreating smoke-stained armor, no burned flesh visible; Mikado approaches with luminous hand edge.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「討伐証明に、その角と装具をいただく」

panels.visual: Decisive stroke shown entirely as black silhouette against white flash, no severed body parts or blood.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……終わりだ」

panels.visual: Archdemon now dissolves into ash, intact detached fantasy horn and armor relic on ground, Mikado picks up relic.
panels.dialogue: ナレーション「魔王種の脅威は、灰へと消えた」

panels.visual: Homura happily runs to Mikado, he gently touches top of her head.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「怪我はないか？」／ホムラ「全然！ 準備運動にもならなかったぜ！」

panels.visual: Mikado pauses with relic pouch, hears footsteps from cave shadow; Homura turns ready.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……この気配。朝の暗殺者か」

panels.visual: Aera steps out with hands clear of sheathed dagger, composed face betrays slight blush.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……規格外だな。ずっと見ていた」

panels.visual: Homura angry interposes, Mikado stops her with open palm.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「ミカドを暗殺だと！？」／ミカド「今度は仕掛けてこないんだな」

panels.visual: Aera looks straight at Mikado, unsparing honest line in closeup.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……あなたの顔を見ていたら、殺すのが惜しくなった」

panels.visual: Mikado has flat disbelieving expression, Homura explosive manga anger at side.
panels.dialogue: ミカド心中「……この世界の奴らはどうなっているんだ」

panels.visual: Mikado lowers guard, Aera startled hopeful.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……まあいい。その言葉、信じるよ」

panels.visual: Aera takes a small step closer, eyes quietly determined, nonsexual.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「私は影。邪魔はしない。ただ、あなたの近くにいたい」

panels.visual: Mikado gives formal assignment while Homura points in sarcastic triumph.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「なら、ヤミの配下につけ。後で連絡する」／アエラ「……分かった。私の主は、あなただけ」

panels.visual: Evening capital square, Aera waiting at fountain rejoins Mikado. Ayame appears with little bells, mischievous grin.
panels.dialogue: アヤメ「みーかどお兄さん！ また迷子ですかぁ？」

panels.visual: Mikado gestures toward Aera explaining assignment; Ayame peers with impish curiosity.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「ちょうどいい。この女をパレスへ。ヤミの配下につけてくれ」

panels.visual: Shino steps into view holding structurally complete Japanese parasol with continuous canopy ribs shaft handle and gripping hand.
panels.dialogue: シノ「闇軍団副官として、わっちがお預かりしんす」

panels.visual: Aera walks through portal with Ayame and Shino, looks back once at Mikado. Max three main figures in this panel.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「シノ、お前も注視してくれると助かる」／シノ「承知いたしんした」

panels.visual: After Aera departs, Mikado turns to disgruntled Homura on sunset street.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「戻る前に、最後に行きたいところはないか？」

panels.visual: Homura lights up and holds his arm nonsexually.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「美味い酒！ 王都で一番のやつ！」

panels.visual: Tavern table with empty mugs, Homura boastful then suddenly asleep in comic beat; Mikado has water glass. No erotic emphasis.
panels.dialogue: ホムラ「まだまだ飲めるぜぇ……ぐぅ」

panels.visual: Mikado carries sleeping Homura safely on back down quiet street, her armored cape draped securely.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……世話の焼ける奴だ」

panels.visual: After putting sleeping Homura safely to bed, Mikado visits Yami office at night to discuss Aera; Yami presses fingertips to desk, shadow deepens behind her.
panels.dialogue: ナレーション「夜、闇軍団執務室」／ヤミ「ミカド様の影は、私一人で十分です」

panels.visual: Mikado meets eyes firmly, not mocking.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「隠密の腕は立つ。パレスの戦力になると思ったんだ」

panels.visual: Mikado reaches to lightly pat Yami head, she blushes at trust.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「だから、お前に預けた。頼むぞ」

panels.visual: Yami bows formally, fierce commitment under composed face.
panels.dialogue: ヤミ「……御意に。期待に応えてみせます」

panels.visual: Yami lightly catches Mikado coat hem as he turns to leave, shy expression, both fully dressed, upright normal pose.
panels.dialogue: ヤミ「……もう、お帰りになるのですか？」

panels.visual: Tender close-up of brief ordinary closed-mouth goodbye kiss, faces and shoulders only, no erotic styling, fully clothed; manga blush.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「今日はこれで許してくれ。流石に疲れた」

panels.visual: Yami touches lips with a fingertip, sweet stunned smile, no arousal cues.
panels.dialogue: ヤミ「……三日は眠れそうにありません」

panels.visual: Mikado at doorway deadpan, Yami behind flustered.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「仕事に支障が出るぞ。ちゃんと休めよ」

panels.visual: Mikado knocks and waits for reply then enters Aera modest new room; Aera seated fully clothed, training bandage on forearm only.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「入ってもいいか？」／アエラ「……どうぞ、主」

panels.visual: Mikado sits on spare chair at normal distance, asks directly.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「今更だが、なぜ従う気になった？」

panels.visual: Aera looks down at hands then up, serious backstory illustrated by vague alley memory silhouettes.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「血と泥しか知らなかった。でも、あなたは違った」

panels.visual: Close Aera eyes with clear highlights, slight blush, Mikado listens offscreen.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「この光のそばにいたい。あなたが光であるために、私が影になる」

panels.visual: Next day afternoon school corridor, Mikado now in established black uniform walking under curious whispers.
panels.dialogue: ナレーション「翌日、放課後」／ミカド心中「さて、面倒なお小言の始まりか」

panels.visual: Council office Charle behind paperwork desk, Ashe by open window with unlit cigarette held low; tidy sparse interior.
panels.dialogue: シャルル「昨日の呼び出し、忘れたわけではないでしょうね？」

panels.visual: Mikado shrugs politely in front of their desk.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「すみません。少々、立て込んでいまして」

panels.visual: Charle leans forward, concern more than anger.
panels.dialogue: シャルル「輝龍の共闘討伐だけでも、国を揺るがす事件なのよ」

panels.visual: Charle lowers voice, Ashe now listening intently.
panels.dialogue: シャルル「今朝、大悪魔討伐の通達があったわ。まさか、これも？」

panels.visual: Mikado pulls black horn and detached empty armor relic from small magic space onto council table, no body parts beyond fantasy horn.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「ギルドで依頼を受けたので。ついでに片付けてきました」

panels.visual: Big reaction panel Charle springs up pale, Ashe almost drops unlit cigarette from hand.
panels.dialogue: シャルル「ついで！？」／アッシェ「魔王種だぞ……お前、一体何者だ？」

panels.visual: Mikado turns toward door, calm face.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「さーて、これで用は済みましたか？」

panels.visual: Charle stops him verbally while Ashe steps near doorway with challenging grin, no blocking coercion.
panels.dialogue: シャルル「済んだわけないでしょう！」

panels.visual: Close Ashe flexes one fist, sharp competitive smile.
panels.dialogue: アッシェ「来月の武神祭、出るよな？ このアタシが確かめてやる」

panels.visual: Mikado answers with confident half-smile over shoulder, very long hair trailing.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「その時は相手します。では」

panels.visual: Mikado exits, door closes, Charle rubs brow while Ashe grins.
panels.dialogue: アッシェ「……面白ぇ一年が入ったな」

panels.visual: Underground training hall shadow corps, Shino with closed complete parasol sparring with Aera, no blood or torn exposure.
panels.dialogue: ナレーション「オルタパレス・闇軍団修練場」

panels.visual: Mikado enters, Aera halts with sweat and surprise; Shino bows elegantly.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「アエラは、もう昇進か？」

panels.visual: Shino gestures at Aera with closed intact parasol shaft, not fan.
panels.dialogue: シノ「基礎はできておりんす。上級兵の技を教えているところで」

panels.visual: Aera eyes dart to Mikado blushing, wipes brow quickly.
panels.dialogue: アエラ心中「見られてる……汗、変な匂いしないかな」

panels.visual: Mikado rolls wrist, invites sparring; Aera still tired.
panels.dialogue: ナレーション「手合わせは、中庭へ――」／ミカド「俺から一本取ったら、ツーショットを撮ってやろう」

panels.visual: Aera instantly becomes intensely focused, large shocked hopeful eyes, black hair highlights.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……ツーショット！」

panels.visual: Aera launches diagonal fast attack, purple-like energy rendered hatching around dagger.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「絶対に、取る――影刃！」

panels.visual: Mikado evades by tiny step, Shino quietly observes holding parasol vertically.
panels.dialogue: ミカド心中「餌が大きすぎたか」

panels.visual: During paused spar, Ayame darts toward Mikado from rear with mischievous grin, Aera in background glares.
panels.dialogue: アヤメ「ミカドお兄さん！ あたしも混ざっていいですかぁ？」

panels.visual: Yami emerges from shadow and catches Ayame by back of collar safely, feet near ground, no neck grabbing.
panels.dialogue: ヤミ「……アヤメ。訓練の邪魔をしない」

panels.visual: Ayame sulks with folded arms beside Yami at wall; two people only.
panels.dialogue: アヤメ「お姉ちゃんのけち……」

panels.visual: Aera and Mikado resume focused battle, Yami offscreen; no four figures crammed.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……主とのツーショットは、私のもの！」

panels.visual: Fast Aera dagger slash just misses Mikado shoulder, clear body motion.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「うおっと。やはり速いな」

panels.visual: He parries lightly, gives technical advice; Aera takes step back.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「直線が多い。もっと影を使え」

panels.visual: Large action panel: exactly THREE Aera figures, one real and two shadow doubles, approach Mikado from three angles. Four figures total.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……これで、逃がさない！」

panels.visual: Close Mikado eye notices flicker at real Aera foot shadow.
panels.dialogue: ミカド心中「本物の影が、わずかに揺れた」

panels.visual: Mikado deflects real dagger cleanly into air, two shadow doubles vanish into smoke; impact not injury.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「そこだ」／効果音「キィン！」

panels.visual: Mikado stops open hand safely short of Aera face, she freezes then slumps disappointed.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「残念だったな。俺の勝ちだ」／アエラ「ツーショット……」

panels.visual: Mikado smiles and shows small photo on comm device, Aera perks up with starry eyes.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「想像以上だ。努力賞に、俺の顔写真くらいはくれてやろう」

panels.visual: Mikado addresses Yami and Shino, Aera at edge as fourth person max; Shino closed parasol intact.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「もっと昇格させていい。あっという間にナンバースリーになるぞ」

panels.visual: Mikado leaves loud training wing, opens bright clean clinic door; Keto with long white hair and white military physician uniform, no glasses looks up warmly.
panels.dialogue: ミカド心中「少し、静かな場所で休むか」

panels.visual: Keto stands beside examination bed, concerned face.
panels.dialogue: ケト「どこか、お怪我でも？」／ミカド「いや。少し休ませてくれ」

panels.visual: Keto seated beside bed invites innocent lap pillow; normal fully clothed figures, frame faces hands shoulders, no chest emphasis.
panels.dialogue: ケト「では、私の膝でゆっくりどうぞ」

panels.visual: Mikado rests head on her lap, wide side view peaceful, Keto surprised shy smile, no glasses.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「……ああ。じゃあ遠慮なく」／ケト「ほ、本当に……？」

panels.visual: Close peaceful Mikado looking up at Keto long hair as she gently strokes his silver hair; faces only.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「お前の髪、綺麗だな」

panels.visual: Keto blushes and freezes, hand hovering, long white hair gleams softly.
panels.dialogue: ケト「急に褒めるなんて……ずるいですよ」

panels.visual: Later Keto has dozed seated and head tilts onto Mikado HEAD/shoulder, blankets bunched; comic trapped hairstyle, absolutely no chest pressing or sexual contact.
panels.dialogue: ミカド心中「……お前も疲れていたのか」

panels.visual: Mikado carefully supports her shoulder and lays pillow behind her head then leaves, Keto peaceful.
panels.dialogue: ミカド「ちゃんと休めよ。……次のホムラとの約束もあるしな」

panels.visual: Night Aera new plain room, she sits on bed fully clothed holding small printed headshot of Mikado with both hands, lovingly careful.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「……主。私の、光」

panels.visual: Close hands trace PHOTO edge, not body; small remembered inset of Mikado giving effort award.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「特訓も全部、耐え抜く。もっと強くなる」

panels.visual: Large final panel Aera face half in moon shadow with clear bright eyes and faint unsettling smile, framed by window, no sexual arousal. Her reflection and photo form strong composition.
panels.dialogue: アエラ「あなたが光であるために――私が影になる」／締め「光を追う影　了」
